title: Evidence staging windows, retention cutover & audit-log cutover plan for regional compliance
creator: Daniel Park
description: Coordinate a repeatable evidence staging and retention cutover process across NA/EU/APAC to support SOC2 & ISO audit windows. Define blackout windows, staged cutovers for audit_log retention policy changes, customer-scoped retention toggles, and automated evidence bundles for auditors. Deliverables: cutover runbook, calendar automation, rollback playbook, Confluence PRD, and a dashboard for proof-of-evidence ingestion velocity.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook published in Confluence with step-by-step cutover and rollback steps
Automated calendar entries generated for each region with blackout windows and owner assignments
Audit-log retention change executed in staging and validated end-to-end with sampler customers
Evidence bundle export produces signed manifests matching auditor schema
Oncall playbook and post-cutover verification scripts added to ops repository
Stakeholder sign-off from Security, Legal, and Compliance teams recorded
tasks: Draft Confluence PRD linked to compliance roadmap (owner: Marina)
Define ingestion verification queries and thresholds (owner: Ryan Patel)
Implement calendar automation to create region-specific blackout slots (owner: Platform SRE)
Build evidence bundler that exports logs + manifests to S3 with immutability flag (owner: Eng - Logs)
Run staged retention change in eu-west-1 on 2025-03-22 (owner: Dedicated Ops)
Execute dry-run with two internal customers and collect feedback (owner: Solutions)
Add dashboard tile for evidence ingestion latency and bundle completeness (owner: Observability)
Finalize rollback and postmortem template (owner: Incident Lead)
comments: 2025-02-01: Kickoff meeting with Security, Compliance, and Platform SRE. Consensus to do region-by-region staged rollout. Action: Platform SRE to draft blackout slot calendar template.

2025-02-12: Design review — Legal asked for signed manifests with checksum and KMS key ID. Trade-off: small latency to sign bundles vs audit requirement. Decision: sign bundles using customer-specific KMS alias when customer requests evidence exports.
2025-02-20: Engineering implementation note — evidence bundler will use S3 Object Lock for immutability; initial prototype stores manifests as JSON Lines for easier auditor parsing.
2025-02-28: PM note — need to coordinate with Sales Ops for communicating blackout windows to customers with active audits. Marina to draft customer comms template.
2025-03-03: Dry-run prep — Observability created dashboard draft; retention-change playbook created in repo under ops/cutover. Requesting security_review_required flag and tabletop exercise.

2025-03-06: Blocker discovered — one EU tenant uses third-party log forwarding which would break evidence bundle completeness. Mitigation: add pre-cutover check to detect external forwarding and require handshake with customer before cutover. Added as dependency: PM-531210.
